newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT - National Finance rated buy - Merrill.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - National Finance rated buy - Merrill.

text.p: Merrill Lynch on Wednesday upgraded National Finance and Securities to a "buy", citing a liquid balance sheet and strong values as reasons.
"NFS's very liquid and strong balance sheet would allow the company to capitalise on opportunities during 1997," Merrill Lynch said in a new report.
"With 15 billion baht being short-term, low-risk assets. The company appears to be benefitting from the current tight interbank market," it added.

Merrill said NFS stock is currently trading at 26 percent discount to book value. Management has re-affirmed a 50 percent dividend payout, which translates into a yield of 8.1 percent on the current local share prices.

"Though the finance sector's fundamentals are still fragile, values have emerged selectively," it said, adding that the stock earning per share for 1997 has been slightly raised to 4.70 baht from 4.60 baht.

The company management of its foreign exchange positions was also cited as one of the reasons for the upgrade. According to Merrill Lynch, NFS is the only financial institution to have provided for an exchange loss of up to 10 percent of its unhedged forex exposure of $90 million.
